nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives incoming Telegram messages via webhook. Configure your bot token in credentials.

nodes.name: Extract Message Data
nodes.notes: Parses Telegram payload into a clean, normalized message object.

nodes.name: Authenticate Client
nodes.notes: Validates the client API key against Supabase and fetches client configuration.

nodes.name: Client Authenticated?
nodes.notes: Routes to AI agent if client is valid, or sends unauthorized reply.

parameters.text: Sorry, this bot is not configured for your account. Please contact support.

nodes.name: Send Unauthorized Reply
nodes.notes: Sends an error message when client authentication fails.

nodes.name: Fetch Conversation History
nodes.notes: Retrieves the active conversation for this user to provide context to the AI agent.

nodes.name: Build AI Context
nodes.notes: Assembles system prompt, conversation history, and user message for the AI agent.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: Claude-powered AI agent with tool access. Processes the user message and generates a response.

nodes.name: Claude (Anthropic)
nodes.notes: Claude language model. Configure your Anthropic API key in credentials.

parameters.toolDescription: Search for files available for the client. Input should be a search query or filename.

nodes.name: File Search Tool
nodes.notes: Tool for the AI agent to search for files. Implement actual file search logic for your storage backend.

parameters.toolDescription: Make HTTP requests to external APIs. Input should be a JSON string with keys: url, method (GET/POST), headers (object), body (object).

nodes.name: HTTP Request Tool
nodes.notes: Allows the AI agent to make external HTTP requests for data retrieval.

nodes.name: Format Response
nodes.notes: Truncates AI output to Telegram's 4096-char limit and prepares the reply payload.

nodes.name: Send Telegram Reply
nodes.notes: Sends the AI-generated response back to the user in Telegram.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_conversation_id: $json.conversationId, p_message: { role: 'user', content: $json.userMessage, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() } }) }}

nodes.name: Log User Message
nodes.notes: Persists the user's message to the conversation in Supabase.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_conversation_id: $json.conversationId, p_message: { role: 'assistant', content: $json.aiResponse, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() } }) }}

nodes.name: Log AI Response
nodes.notes: Persists the AI response to the conversation in Supabase.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_client_id: $('Format Response').item.json.clientId, p_messages_sent: 1, p_messages_recv: 1, p_tokens_used: 0 }) }}

nodes.name: Increment Usage
nodes.notes: Updates the monthly usage counters in Supabase.
